newsitem.title: USA: Russellville, Ark., $7.5 mln bond vote Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Russellville, Ark., $7.5 mln bond vote Tuesday.

text.p: Russellville, Ark., voters Tuesday will decide whether to approve a bond issue to fund roughly $7.5 million in capital improvements.

Proposed improvements include a new police station, City Hall renovations and expansion of the youth center, which serves as headquarters for the city's parks and recreation department, Susan Brady, personnel director, service coordinator and secretary to the mayor, said. The bond proposal also includes plans to expand Fire Station No. 4., she said.
"Each thing is a separate thing on the ballot, but it's in one bond issue," Brady said.
